previous_anchor_route: stopped at blocked_anchor_support; unchanged, not retried or superseded as a successful metric-depth experiment
question: Does a fixed Small-model raw relative inverse-depth map preserve independently measured within-image near/far relations on this development triple, without anchor or GT affine alignment?
limits: ordinal structure only, no metric-Z accuracy or scale/shift calibration
no evidence of reliability-score ranking or weighting benefit
not evidence for three-view pose/initialization feasibility
not comparable to old AbsRel/GS metrics
terrace GT coverage and RGB already inspected; development diagnostic, not blind testing

forbidden_predictor_inputs: previous diagnostic errors and oracle outputs

prediction.input_assets: only three frozen RGBs plus selected camera/size manifest; no features, anchors, GT or full archives

model.name: Depth Anything V2 Small relative inverse depth
model.output_upsampling: upstream bilinear align_corners=True; do not replace with a new decoder

prediction.output: one native-work-grid nonnegative float32 raw relative inverse-depth map per image; never align, invert to Z, normalize by GT, or change sign

mapping.GT: native little-endian float32 axial Z, finite positive only; no interpolation or filling
mapping.sample_prediction: float64 bilinear interpolation of raw q at native centers; all four contributors finite and >=0, including zero-weight neighbors
mapping.zero_prediction: valid, including all-zero constant maps; exact ties carry loss0.5
mapping.invalid_prediction: negative/nonfinite contributor or out-of-domain sampling; pair loss1 if either endpoint invalid
mapping.old_helper_difference: old helper rejects q<=1e-6 and assumes positive aligned inverse-Z; must not use that mask for relative raw maps

sampling.runtime: NumPy1.26.4 PCG64; integer seeds and native row-major ordering explicit
sampling.GT_samples: within each cell and fixed domain enumerate positive finite native GT indices ascending; if count>64 select first64 of rng.permutation(count), else all; sort selected native linear indices

pairs.eligibility: max(Za,Zb)/min(Za,Zb)>=1.10 in float64; fixed 10% contrast filter, not a sensor-uncertainty guarantee

local.pool: all unordered pairs of selected nodes within each cell, lexicographic native index pairs
local.draw: if pool>256 take first256 of PCG64 permutation(pool size); otherwise all; then apply GT contrast; no refill

cross.target_cells: nonempty cells at Chebyshev cell distance>=3, ascending cell index
cross.draw: 256 draws with replacement; each draw uses source-node index then target-cell index then target-node index, each rng.integers; source/target lists sorted; canonicalize endpoint order and deduplicate within source cell, then GT contrast; no refill
cross.cross_source_duplicates: retain source-cell memberships for equal source-cell aggregation; report canonical unique count and repeated-pair count; no independence claim

loss.target_order: higher q means smaller Z, fixed sign before evaluation
loss.correct: (qa-qb)*(Za-Zb)<0 =>0, use sign comparison rather than overflow-prone products in implementation
loss.exact_prediction_tie: qa==qb =>0.5; no learned or scale-dependent epsilon
loss.aggregation: per eligible cell mean; each stratum mean over cells with>=16 contrast-eligible pairs; image loss=(local_cell_macro+cross_source_cell_macro)/2; scene loss=mean of all three image losses
loss.no_pooling: do not pool pixels, pairs, cells or images into iid inference
loss.invalid_fraction_denominators: nodes: all sampled GT nodes; pair endpoint invalid: eligible pairs in included cells of each primary stratum; excluded-cell invalid counts also reported

controls.constant: q=1 everywhere: every eligible pair loss0.5; finite all-zero raw model also loss0.5, not excluded

shuffled.order: one PCG64 permutation of finite nonnegative sampled-node q values in native-index ascending order, keeping invalid-node mask fixed; reuse resulting node values across all local/cross pairs
shuffled.report: every seed, each stratum/image loss, mean/min/max; no p-value or significance claim

controls.oracle: q=1/Z at sampled reference nodes in evaluator only; all eligible pairs must have loss0; never exported as predictions or weights
controls.no_confidence_or_risk_curve: no candidate reliability score here; old confidence/risk curves not carried over or tuned
controls.direction: never select the negative-sign result or shuffle seed after seeing GT

support_gates.on_failure: blocked_relative_support; report every empty/low-contrast/insufficient cell and stop acceptance; preserve computed image summaries; do not alter margin/grid/sampling or omit an image

acceptance.engineering: all synthetic mapping, order/tie/invalid, determinism, independent arithmetic and CPU/GPU isolation checks passed; all inputs/code/predictions sealed
acceptance.meaning: operational screen for usable ordinal signal only; not statistical significance, calibrated geometric error or research-performance acceptance
acceptance.on_failure: stop fixed relative pilot; do not tune sign, contrast, sample size or add inference/scenes
acceptance.on_success: supports reviewing whether a separate relative-error target and falsifiable score are worth studying; never directly releases metric alignment, reliability weighting or GS training

required_reports: native GT coverage, fixed-domain exclusions, sampled-node counts and identities
all candidate, duplicate, contrast-excluded, low-support and retained pair/cell counts
local/cross per-cell losses and image/scene equal-weight means
invalid node and invalid endpoint-pair counts, exact prediction ties, all denominators
constant, every shuffled control, evaluator-only oracle
secondary Spearman on sampled valid nodes with average ranks; ties/constant =>unknown; valid-only denominator explicit; never replaces primary loss
sampled ordinal errors are pair relations; do not paint them as dense per-pixel metric residuals
GPU actual allocated/reserved/board peak, inference time, CPU wall/RSS, all failures and unknowns
synthetic_acceptance: known correct and reversed near/far relations, repeated nodes/cells and canonical pair handling
all-zero and positive constants valid with loss0.5; invalid endpoints loss1 never dropped
nonlinear strictly increasing q transforms can score perfectly despite wrong metric depth; explicit counterexample
positive affine order invariance; monotone endpoint-value order invariance on valid nonnegative examples (not invariance of nonlinear image transforms before interpolation); no sign flip accepted
native/work half-pixel mapping and four-contributor interpolation; zero neighbor valid, negative/nonfinite invalid
GT ties and below/exact/above1.10 contrast, empty cells, insufficient local/cross support, frozen RNG reproducibility
changing predictions cannot alter node/pair membership or GT eligibility; changing evaluator labels cannot alter predictor manifest or synthetic predictions
prediction sealing before real GT read; no output overwrite or source/input digest drift
constant and oracle closed-form losses; one node permutation reused across correlated pairs

isolation.CPU: reuse reviewed bubblewrap white-list design after independent new-entry tests; old audit hook alone insufficient
isolation.GPU: not yet validated; future preflight must expose necessary local CUDA device/runtime only while GT/archives/other views remain invisible; fail closed if unavailable
isolation.predictor_reads: three RGBs/camera export, frozen model code/weights and necessary runtime only
isolation.evaluator_reads: separate CPU process: sealed raw predictions and three evaluator GT files; no model, weights, anchors or feature caches

resources.streaming: one image/cell/control seed at a time, no native all-pairs enumeration
resources.anomaly: stop and preserve; no automatic retry or resolution/precision change

release_order: current: design/provenance/consistency review only; no executable implementation or new GT/prediction results
next separate authorization: minimal CPU ordinal evaluator and synthetic/isolation checks only, no real GT analysis or GPU/model call
after CPU acceptance and separate authorization: GPU-isolation/forward preflight and exactly three Small passes; seal all outputs, then one unified CPU evaluation
stop with complete comparison, failed/unknown evidence and next-stage judgment; no reliability or training release
cumulative_contribution: independent sensor-reference intake and a falsifiable ordinal-only fallback after genuine anchor-support failure; no new accuracy, confidence ranking or method novelty established
